name: Community Wetland Restoration Grant Program
summary: Small grants for community-based restoration of coastal wetlands and coastal stream corridors in Southern California. Projects must include education and community involvement.

status.quote: The Request for Proposals (RFP) for the Community Wetland Restoration Grant Program is closed until 2027.

geography.quote: provides funding for community-based restoration projects in coastal wetlands and along coastal stream corridors in the Southern California region
